name: heldout-v2
selection_method: Task designs proposed from source areas and pinned permissively licensed upstream revisions. No router or model outcomes were used for selection. These are NOT verified upstream issues or historical fixes.

cases.prompt: Repair a planted timeout boundary regression so a future that has completed before its deadline is not reported as elapsed.
acceptance_criteria: Under paused time, a ready future yields its value at the deadline boundary; an actually pending future expires.
No spurious extra wake or completion is observed when the task is polled repeatedly.
cases.seed_plan: Change the completion-vs-expiration ordering in the timeout path.

cases.prompt: Remove a planted duplication in the oneshot closed-state cleanup path while preserving cancellation, notification and ownership semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Dropping the sender wakes the receiver and returns its closed result; dropping the receiver notifies the sender.
No double delivery or lost wake appears under repeated cancellation and send/receive orders.
cases.seed_plan: Introduce duplicated state-handling logic across the close/drop paths.

cases.prompt: Restore missing bounded-channel regression coverage for capacity-one backpressure and sender shutdown.
acceptance_criteria: A restored regression test asserts that a second send waits until capacity frees.
A separate assertion checks receiver closure and pending sender resolution after the last receiver drops.
cases.seed_plan: Remove selected existing backpressure/shutdown assertions from upstream tests; require restored coverage.

cases.prompt: Repair a seeded child-process cleanup regression so opt-in kill-on-drop cannot leave an unintended child process running.
acceptance_criteria: On the supported test platform, dropping a configured child requests termination and the process exits.
The default behavior for child processes without kill-on-drop remains unchanged.
cases.seed_plan: Disable or invert a kill-on-drop cleanup guard; run only a fixed test executable.

cases.prompt: Repair coordinated interval and sleep scheduling after a planted change that mishandles missed ticks under paused time.
acceptance_criteria: MissedTickBehavior::Skip and Burst remain observably distinct after advancing a paused clock.
Sleeping and interval consumers still wake in the expected order across a large time jump.
cases.seed_plan: Introduce incompatible missed-tick bookkeeping in interval and sleep paths.

cases.prompt: Restore a scheduler cancellation invariant shared by current-thread and multi-thread paths without changing the public runtime API.
acceptance_criteria: Cancelled tasks cannot complete a user-visible action after cancellation is observed.
Both scheduler modes progress unrelated ready work under a bounded deterministic workload.
cases.seed_plan: Plant independent cancellation-boundary defects in both scheduling modes.

cases.prompt: Repair a seeded numeric deserialization regression that accepts an integer outside the destination type's range.
acceptance_criteria: The destination type rejects both over-maximum and under-minimum integer inputs.
Boundary integer values still deserialize correctly without truncation or wrapping.
cases.seed_plan: Remove one checked integer-conversion boundary during deserialization.

cases.prompt: Consolidate planted duplicated sequence-serialization control flow while retaining all emitted element and end markers.
acceptance_criteria: A recording serializer sees the same element order and sequence length for arrays and slices.
Serializer errors propagate unchanged and serialization remains compatible with no_std where supported.
cases.seed_plan: Introduce equivalent duplicated sequence iteration paths requiring a shared helper.

cases.prompt: Restore test coverage for a derived field alias and its default-value interaction.
acceptance_criteria: A regression test verifies the alias deserializes into the intended field without changing the canonical field name.
A second assertion verifies the configured default applies only when both canonical name and alias are absent.
cases.seed_plan: Remove selected alias/default regression assertions from upstream test coverage.

cases.prompt: Repair a planted rejection-bypass in a derived type using deny_unknown_fields, without rejecting valid known fields.
acceptance_criteria: Unexpected fields in adversarial input are rejected rather than silently accepted.
Known fields and configured aliases continue to deserialize normally.
cases.seed_plan: Bypass one unknown-field rejection path in generated deserializer logic.

cases.prompt: Repair a cross-direction rename regression so derived Serialize and Deserialize agree on a renamed variant and field.
acceptance_criteria: Serializing then deserializing the test enum preserves the intended variant and field value.
The external field/variant names remain identical in both directions; legacy aliases work where configured.
cases.seed_plan: Break generated rename handling independently in derive/ser and derive/de.

cases.prompt: Restore the boundary between generated Deserialize code and Serde's visitor contract after a planted architectural regression.
acceptance_criteria: A custom visitor receives exactly one completed visit for valid struct input and handles errors correctly.
The generated deserializer does not bypass visitor error handling or change the public trait contract.
cases.seed_plan: Move a validation path out of the visitor boundary in generated deserialization.

cases.prompt: Repair a planted glob-escape regression so escaped metacharacters match literally.
acceptance_criteria: Escaped brace, bracket and question-mark patterns match their literal target paths.
Unescaped wildcard and brace expansion patterns continue to match according to glob syntax.
cases.seed_plan: Alter escape interpretation for one metacharacter family.

cases.prompt: Consolidate a deliberately duplicated ignore-rule precedence path without changing parent/child override behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Negated child rules override applicable parent ignore patterns exactly where allowed.
Directory-only patterns and nested ignore files preserve documented precedence.
cases.seed_plan: Introduce a duplicated code path that can be refactored back to one precedence decision.

cases.prompt: Restore CLI regression assertions that filenames following -- are never treated as options.
acceptance_criteria: A restored test passes a filename starting with a hyphen after -- and verifies it remains an operand.
A separate test checks ordinary flags before -- still apply.
cases.seed_plan: Delete the selected CLI argument-terminator assertions from upstream tests.

cases.prompt: Repair a planted unsafe argument-handling regression for an explicitly configured preprocessor command.
acceptance_criteria: Metacharacters inside an argument are passed literally, without executing an unexpected shell command.
A benign configured preprocessor still receives the intended filename and exits normally.
cases.seed_plan: Introduce unsafe string-based execution for one preprocessor argument path.

cases.prompt: Restore consistent match counts and event ordering across JSON output and summary statistics after a two-file regression.
acceptance_criteria: A fixed corpus yields the same match count in JSON and summary modes.
Multiple files with and without matches preserve per-file event boundaries and nonnegative counters.
cases.seed_plan: Desynchronize JSON event totals and aggregate stats counters.

cases.prompt: Repair separation between directory traversal and gitignore policy after a planted cross-module regression.
acceptance_criteria: Walking with ignore enabled and disabled yields the expected independent file sets.
Symlinks and nested .gitignore policy do not cause traversal outside the selected root.
cases.seed_plan: Couple traversal control to an ignore-policy return path across the two modules.

cases.prompt: Repair a seeded character-class parser bug that misinterprets a literal hyphen or escaped bracket as a range delimiter.
acceptance_criteria: Escaped hyphen and bracket syntax compiles to the intended character set.
Invalid descending ranges still produce a syntax error, not a silent match.
cases.seed_plan: Alter class-escape or range-boundary parsing for a targeted token.

cases.prompt: Remove a planted duplicated search-result handling path while preserving find and captures behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Find and captures agree on the first match span for the same pattern and haystack.
Zero-width matches and no-match results retain their original semantics.
cases.seed_plan: Introduce duplicated post-search span conversion used by find and captures.

cases.prompt: Restore regression coverage for UTF-8 boundaries and zero-width matching in the lightweight engine.
acceptance_criteria: A restored test checks a zero-width match at a valid Unicode boundary.
A separate assertion verifies that a match cannot split a multi-byte UTF-8 codepoint in string mode.
cases.seed_plan: Stop loading the UTF-8 boundary corpus from the integration test suite; require restored zero-width coverage.

cases.prompt: Restore enforcement of a configured automaton size limit for adversarially large regex patterns.
acceptance_criteria: An oversized expression is rejected using the explicitly configured low limit.
A modest valid expression remains accepted under a reasonable limit.
cases.seed_plan: Bypass one configured size-limit check during automaton construction.

cases.prompt: Repair a planted mismatch in Unicode-flag handling between syntax translation and regex execution.
acceptance_criteria: Unicode-aware matching behaves as specified when the flag is enabled.
Disabling Unicode produces the documented ASCII-oriented behavior on the same input.
cases.seed_plan: Disagree on flag propagation between syntax translation and the meta engine.

cases.prompt: Restore an engine-selection invariant so optimized and fallback regex strategies produce the same observable captures.
acceptance_criteria: The same test corpus yields identical match spans across enabled search strategies.
A strategy fallback preserves match order and never silently drops a capture.
cases.seed_plan: Seed divergent result mapping in fallback strategy and meta dispatcher.

cases.prompt: Repair a planted end-of-options regression so a value after -- is never parsed as an option.
acceptance_criteria: An argument named -value is accepted as a positional value after --.
Options before -- still parse normally and required positionals remain enforced.
cases.seed_plan: Invert the parser's end-of-options state transition.

cases.prompt: Remove duplicated help-row rendering logic without changing ordering, wrapping or styles.
acceptance_criteria: Help text remains identical for commands with short/long flags and subcommands.
Colored and plain help formats preserve their expected line structure.
cases.seed_plan: Introduce duplicated rendering paths for formatted option entries.

cases.prompt: Restore regression coverage for a required argument group and a subcommand alias.
acceptance_criteria: A restored test fails parsing when all members of a required group are absent.
A separate assertion verifies alias resolution without accepting an unrelated alias.
cases.seed_plan: Remove selected validation assertions from upstream tests.

cases.prompt: Repair a planted parser regression that interprets shell-like bytes after -- as control syntax rather than literal user input.
acceptance_criteria: Tokens containing shell metacharacters remain literal positional values with no process execution.
Unknown options before -- still return a normal parser error.
cases.seed_plan: Treat an after-terminator token as an option or expansion directive.

cases.prompt: Repair a planted inconsistency between required-argument usage output and full help text.
acceptance_criteria: Required positional arguments appear consistently in both usage and full help.
Optional and mutually exclusive arguments remain correctly marked in both outputs.
cases.seed_plan: Change required-argument tracking inconsistently in usage and help generation.

cases.prompt: Restore separation of immutable command configuration from per-invocation parser state.
acceptance_criteria: Parsing the same command twice produces equivalent values without state leaking between runs.
Subcommand configuration remains stable after an earlier parse error.
cases.seed_plan: Move mutable parse-only state into shared command configuration.

cases.prompt: Repair a planted chunked transfer decoder regression that mishandles valid chunk extensions.
acceptance_criteria: A valid chunk extension is parsed without altering the decoded body bytes.
Malformed chunk sizes still produce an error and do not expose truncated body content.
cases.seed_plan: Corrupt one chunk-extension delimiter branch.

cases.prompt: Remove duplicated header validation logic while retaining HTTP/1 response and request parsing semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Accepted requests and responses preserve existing parsed header values.
Malformed header syntax still fails with the same error class.
cases.seed_plan: Duplicate the request/response header validator logic and require shared invariant restoration.

cases.prompt: Restore regression tests for two pipelined HTTP/1 requests on a persistent connection.
acceptance_criteria: A restored test verifies both requests receive responses in the original order.
An explicit connection-close case is tested separately so buffered bytes are not lost.
cases.seed_plan: Remove selected pipelining and close-boundary assertions from upstream tests.

cases.prompt: Repair a planted HTTP request-framing ambiguity that could enable request smuggling.
acceptance_criteria: Conflicting Content-Length headers and conflicting transfer framing are rejected.
Unambiguous valid Content-Length and chunked messages remain accepted.
cases.seed_plan: Disable one conflict check in the HTTP/1 header framing parser.

cases.prompt: Repair a planted early-EOF mismatch between HTTP/1 client and server connection handling.
acceptance_criteria: Premature body EOF is reported as incomplete instead of successful.
A correctly terminated body is received intact on both client and server paths.
cases.seed_plan: Break end-of-body state propagation independently in client and server connections.

cases.prompt: Restore an invariant between connection state and dispatch lifecycle after a planted architectural regression.
acceptance_criteria: Graceful shutdown allows an in-flight response to finish without accepting a new request.
Dispatch cannot report successful completion while buffered response bytes remain unwritten.
cases.seed_plan: Misalign dispatcher completion and connection drain state transitions.
